text:
maria-ko: Heads-up — seeing sustained queue depth growth for rw-v2-13b in us-west-2 over the last 30m. Pending requests ~1.2k, p95 latency creeping past 900ms. Noticed more low-priority traffic spiking at once. Anyone else seeing hotspots?

infra-bot: [ALERT] queue_depth high — model=rw-v2-13b region=us-west-2 queue_depth=1208 p95_latency=980ms capacity_util=0.98

jonathan: Can we throttle new low-priority routes? Admission control should've kicked in earlier — current static threshold is 400 but apparently not firing for bursty short requests.

sree: I dug in — adaptive admission was turned off for that pool after the last rollback. We can re-enable adaptive mode and apply a short window rate-limit for anon/low-pri. Also we have a quantized variant (rw-v2-13b-8bit) available in us-east-1 and us-west-2 but only in limited nodes.

mike-l: FYI provisioning in us-west-2 is spotty right now. If we try to spin up 2 more T4/GPU nodes it may take 20–35m (spot fallback -> on-demand). If we go reserved, longer lead time.

olivia: From a cost POV prefer throttling/fallback first. Scaling will burn $$$ and might still not absorb the instant bursts.

jonathan: Proposed triage steps:
1) Enable adaptive admission on rw-v2-13b-usw2 and set anon/low-priority rate caps (10 r/s for anon, 50 r/s for low-pri) for 15m.
2) Prioritize enterprise routes by pinning to dedicated nodes (no admission for enterprise).
3) Start provisioning 2 nodes in us-west-2 as warm standby but don't attach until queue normalizes.
Any objections?

maria-ko: +1. Also let's add 30% cross-region spill to rw-v2-13b-8bit in us-east-1 for low-pri if latency impact is acceptable.

sree: I'll run the changes. Command (dry-run then apply):
```
rctl admission set --pool rw-v2-13b-usw2 --mode adaptive --anon-rate 10 --lowpri-rate 50 --duration 15m
rctl route update --source low-pri --spill us-east-1:rw-v2-13b-8bit --spill-percent 30
``` 
Applying now — will report back once effective.

infra-bot: change requested by sree — admission_mode=adaptive anon_rate=10 lowpri_rate=50 spill=us-east-1:rw-v2-13b-8bit:30%

sree: Applied. Dry-run ok, flip in 45s.

infra-bot: change applied by sree — admission_mode=adaptive anon_rate=10 lowpri_rate=50

mike-l: Started provisioning nodes: aws run-instances ... => i-0ab1cde2f3gh4ijk, i-0klm5nop6qr7stu8. Estimated ready 22m.

olivia: I'll update cost tracker with expected +$42/hr if we attach both. Also creating a temporary enterprise routing rule to avoid any impact to paid customers.

jonathan: Add monitoring tweak: alert if queue_depth > 500 for >5m -> page eng-sre. And log every admission event to kinesis so we can replay and measure reject rate.

maria-ko: Thanks all. Follow-up: if we see recurrence in 24h let's schedule a short postmortem and update runbook for this specific model/region pattern. I'll add a short note to runbooks/queue-triage.

sree: Post-change snapshot (from metrics):
- rw-v2-13b us-west-2: pending=238 avg_wait=2.1s p95=650ms
- rw-v2-13b-8bit us-east-1: pending=72 avg_wait=1.9s p95=720ms
- total rejects (low-pri) in last 2m = 94

jonathan: Looks like policy helped. Keep monitoring for 30m, then we can decide on attaching the new nodes.

maria-ko: Closing loop — will post final status in 30m. Thanks :thumbsup:
